title: Bastion Gold Tools ✨
description: A resourcepack that changes gold tools to be visually made by piglins.
body:
# Gold Tools -> ✨ Bastion Gold Tools ✨

A Minecraft resourcepack to make your gold tools look like they don't belong to you!

Perfect for getting impaled by while looting treasure!

### Description;

A resourcepack that changes gold tools to be made by piglins.
![Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4dabdde1469479a0e99a265965fd3c001c343277.png)


### Other Info;

Dependencies-

No hard mod requirements.

No soft mod requirements.


Version-

Revision 0 - Minecraft 26.1+

My packs are default released for latest version of Minecraft- if you want it ported to a newer or older version let me know. _(*Done at my discretion. Some things may be too difficult to port.)_
